```{r}
# ===== MERGE REPLICATES PER CONDITION =====
# Using deeptools bigwigAverage to merge replicates

system("mkdir -p bigwig_files/spikein_merged")

# Merge WT replicates
cmd_merge_wt <- paste(
  "bigwigAverage",
  "-b bigwig_files/spikein_normalized/WT_1_spikein.bw",
  "bigwig_files/spikein_normalized/WT_2_spikein.bw",
  "bigwig_files/spikein_normalized/WT_3_spikein.bw",
  "--binSize 10",
  "-p max",
  "-o bigwig_files/spikein_merged/WT_merged_spikein.bw"
)

# Merge DeltaC replicates
cmd_merge_deltac <- paste(
  "bigwigAverage",
  "-b bigwig_files/spikein_normalized/DeltaC_4_spikein.bw",
  "bigwig_files/spikein_normalized/DeltaC_5_spikein.bw",
  "bigwig_files/spikein_normalized/DeltaC_6_spikein.bw",
  "--binSize 10",
  "-p max",
  "-o bigwig_files/spikein_merged/DeltaC_merged_spikein.bw"
)

# Merge Delta207 replicates
cmd_merge_delta207 <- paste(
  "bigwigAverage",
  "-b bigwig_files/spikein_normalized/Delta207_7_spikein.bw",
  "bigwig_files/spikein_normalized/Delta207_8_spikein.bw",
  "bigwig_files/spikein_normalized/Delta207_9_spikein.bw",
  "--binSize 10",
  "-p max",
  "-o bigwig_files/spikein_merged/Delta207_merged_spikein.bw"
)

# Merge Delta216 replicates
cmd_merge_delta216 <- paste(
  "bigwigAverage",
  "-b bigwig_files/spikein_normalized/Delta216_10_spikein.bw",
  "bigwig_files/spikein_normalized/Delta216_11_spikein.bw",
  "bigwig_files/spikein_normalized/Delta216_12_spikein.bw",
  "--binSize 10",
  "-p max",
  "-o bigwig_files/spikein_merged/Delta216_merged_spikein.bw"
)

# Merge mCherry replicates
cmd_merge_mcherry <- paste(
  "bigwigAverage",
  "-b bigwig_files/spikein_normalized/mCherry_16_spikein.bw",
  "bigwig_files/spikein_normalized/mCherry_17_spikein.bw",
  "bigwig_files/spikein_normalized/mCherry_18_spikein.bw",
  "--binSize 10",
  "-p max",
  "-o bigwig_files/spikein_merged/mCherry_merged_spikein.bw"
)

print("Merging WT replicates...")
system(cmd_merge_wt)

print("Merging DeltaC replicates...")
system(cmd_merge_deltac)

print("Merging Delta207 replicates...")
system(cmd_merge_delta207)

print("Merging Delta216 replicates...")
system(cmd_merge_delta216)

print("Merging mCherry replicates...")
system(cmd_merge_mcherry)


merged_files <- list.files(
  "bigwig_files/spikein_merged/",
  pattern = "*.bw"
)
print(paste("Merged bigwigs created:", 
            length(merged_files)))
print(merged_files)
```

```{r}
colData$condition <- factor(colData$condition, 
                            levels = c("WT", "Delta207", "Delta216", "DeltaC"))

dds_spikein <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(
  countData = countData,
  colData = colData,
  design = ~ condition
)

sizeFactors(dds_spikein) <- spike_size_factors
dds_spikein <- estimateDispersions(dds_spikein)
dds_spikein <- nbinomWaldTest(dds_spikein)

vsd_spikein <- varianceStabilizingTransformation(dds_spikein)

PCA_spikein <- plotPCA(vsd_spikein,
                        intgroup = "condition") +
  geom_mark_hull(
    aes(color = group,
        fill = group),
    alpha = 0.1,
    expand = unit(3, "mm")
  ) +

  expand_limits(y = c(-28, 12)) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c(
      "WT" = "black",
      "Delta207" = "#6BAED6",
      "Delta216" = "#31A354",
      "DeltaC" = "#FF8C00"
    ),
    labels = c(
      "WT" = "WT",
      "Delta207" = "Pdx1∆207",
      "Delta216" = "Pdx1∆216",
      "DeltaC" = "Pdx1∆C"
    ),

    breaks = c("WT", "Delta207", "Delta216", "DeltaC")
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      "WT" = "black",
      "Delta207" = "#6BAED6",
      "Delta216" = "#31A354",
      "DeltaC" = "#FF8C00"
    ),
    labels = c(
      "WT" = "WT",
      "Delta207" = "Pdx1∆207",
      "Delta216" = "Pdx1∆216",
      "DeltaC" = "Pdx1∆C"
    ),

    breaks = c("WT", "Delta207", "Delta216", "DeltaC")
  ) +
  ggtitle("Pdx1 CUT&RUN PCA (Spike-in normalized)") +
  theme_classic()

PCA_spikein

Cairo::Cairo(
  file = "/Volumes/One Touch/CUT_RUN/Pdx1_spikein_PCA_ellipse.png",
  bg = "white", type = "png",
  units = "in", width = 5, height = 5,
  pointsize = 12, dpi = 300
)
print(PCA_spikein)
dev.off()
```


```{r}
# ===== SPIKE-IN RESULTS =====
peakid <- function(df){
  df %>%
    mutate(peakid = paste(chr, start, end, sep = ".")) %>%
    relocate(peakid, .before = "chr")
}


library(tidyverse)
library(dplyr)

result_spikein_Delta207 <- results(dds_spikein,
  contrast = c("condition", "Delta207", "WT")) %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  cbind(count[,c(1,2,3,4)], .) %>%
  peakid()

result_spikein_DeltaC <- results(dds_spikein,
  contrast = c("condition", "DeltaC", "WT")) %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  cbind(count[,c(1,2,3,4)], .) %>%
  peakid()

result_spikein_Delta216 <- results(dds_spikein,
  contrast = c("condition", "Delta216", "WT")) %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  cbind(count[,c(1,2,3,4)], .) %>%
  peakid()


write.table(result_spikein_Delta207,
  file = "/Volumes/One Touch/CUT_RUN/Pdx1_spikein_WT_vs_Delta207.txt",
  sep = "\t", row.names = FALSE, quote = FALSE)

write.table(result_spikein_DeltaC,
  file = "/Volumes/One Touch/CUT_RUN/Pdx1_spikein_WT_vs_DeltaC.txt",
  sep = "\t", row.names = FALSE, quote = FALSE)

write.table(result_spikein_Delta216,
  file = "/Volumes/One Touch/CUT_RUN/Pdx1_spikein_WT_vs_Delta216.txt",
  sep = "\t", row.names = FALSE, quote = FALSE)
```

```{r}
# ===== SPIKE-IN SIGNIFICANT PEAKS =====
Delta207_sig_spikein <- result_spikein_Delta207 |>
  dplyr::filter(padj < 0.05) |>
  dplyr::filter(abs(log2FoldChange) >= 0.585)

DeltaC_sig_spikein <- result_spikein_DeltaC |>
  dplyr::filter(padj < 0.05) |>
  dplyr::filter(abs(log2FoldChange) >= 0.585)

Delta216_sig_spikein <- result_spikein_Delta216 |>
  dplyr::filter(padj < 0.05) |>
  dplyr::filter(abs(log2FoldChange) >= 0.585)

# Compare results
print("=== Spike-in Significant Peaks ===")
print(paste("Delta207:", nrow(Delta207_sig_spikein)))
print(paste("DeltaC:", nrow(DeltaC_sig_spikein)))
print(paste("Delta216:", nrow(Delta216_sig_spikein)))

print(paste("Delta207 gained:", 
  sum(Delta207_sig_spikein$log2FoldChange > 0)))
print(paste("Delta207 lost:", 
  sum(Delta207_sig_spikein$log2FoldChange < 0)))
```

```{r}
library(ComplexHeatmap)
library(circlize)

combined_changes_spikein <- result_spikein_Delta207 %>%
  full_join(result_spikein_DeltaC[,c(1,6:11)],
            by = "peakid",
            suffix = c("_Delta207", "_DeltaC")) %>%
  full_join(result_spikein_Delta216[,c(1,6:11)],
            by = "peakid")

colnames(combined_changes_spikein)[12:17] <- c(
  "baseMean_Delta216",
  "log2FoldChange_Delta216",
  "lfcSE_Delta216",
  "stat_Delta216",
  "pvalue_Delta216",
  "padj_Delta216"
)

combined_changes_spikein <- combined_changes_spikein %>%
  rename(
    baseMean_DeltaC = baseMean,
    log2FoldChange_DeltaC = log2FoldChange,
    lfcSE_DeltaC = lfcSE,
    stat_DeltaC = stat,
    pvalue_DeltaC = pvalue,
    padj_DeltaC = padj
  )

Delta207_sig_spikein_matdata <- inner_join(
  combined_changes_spikein,
  Delta207_sig_spikein,
  by = "peakid"
) %>%
  dplyr::select(peakid,
                log2FoldChange_Delta207,
                log2FoldChange_DeltaC,
                log2FoldChange_Delta216)

print(dim(Delta207_sig_spikein_matdata))

# Build heatmap
rnames <- Delta207_sig_spikein_matdata[, 1]
cnames <- c("∆207", "∆C", "∆216")

  Delta207_sig_spikein_matdata[, c(2:4)])
rownames(mat_data) <- rnames
colnames(mat_data) <- cnames
mat_data[is.na(mat_data)] <- 0

spikein_heatmap
```

```{r}
library(ComplexHeatmap)
library(circlize)

# ===== GET SPIKE-IN NORMALIZED COUNTS =====
# Use VST from spike-in DESeq2
vsd_spikein <- varianceStabilizingTransformation(dds_spikein)
vst_counts_spikein <- assay(vsd_spikein)

# ===== GET SIGNIFICANT PEAK INDICES =====
sig_peak_indices <- which(
  rownames(vst_counts_spikein) %in% 
  rownames(countData)[
    count$chr %in% Delta207_sig_spikein$chr &
    count$start %in% Delta207_sig_spikein$start
  ]
)

# Better approach - match by coordinates
count_peakids <- paste(count$chr, 
                       count$start, 
                       count$end, sep=".")

sig_indices <- which(count_peakids %in% 
                     Delta207_sig_spikein$peakid)

print(paste("Significant peaks found:", 
            length(sig_indices)))

# ===== SUBSET VST COUNTS =====
vst_sig <- vst_counts_spikein[sig_indices, ]

print(dim(vst_sig))

# ===== SET COLUMN NAMES =====
colnames(vst_sig) <- c(
  "WT_1", "WT_2", "WT_3",
  "∆C_4", "∆C_5", "∆C_6",
  "∆207_7", "∆207_8", "∆207_9",
  "∆216_10", "∆216_11", "∆216_12"
)

# ===== SCALE ROWS FOR VISUALIZATION =====
# Z-score each row so patterns are visible
vst_sig_scaled <- t(scale(t(vst_sig)))

# ===== CREATE COLUMN ANNOTATION =====
column_anno <- HeatmapAnnotation(
  Condition = factor(
    c("PDX1 WT","PDX1 WT","PDX1 WT",
      "∆C","∆C","∆C",
      "∆207","∆207","∆207",
      "∆216","∆216","∆216"),
    levels = c("PDX1 WT","∆C","∆207","∆216")  # ← specify order
  ),
  col = list(
    Condition = c(
      "PDX1 WT" = "black",
      "∆C" = "#FF8C00",
      "∆207" = "#6BAED6",
      "∆216" = "#31A354"
    )
  ),
  show_annotation_name = FALSE
)

# ===== COLOR PALETTE =====
# For z-scored data use symmetric scale
my_palette <- colorRamp2(
  c(-2, -1, 0, 1, 2),
  c("darkblue", "blue", "white", "red", "darkred")
)

# ===== BUILD HEATMAP =====
set.seed(123)
spikein_heatmap_wt <- ComplexHeatmap::Heatmap(
  vst_sig_scaled,
  col = my_palette,
  column_title = "∆207 Significant Peaks",
  km = 3,
  row_km_repeats = 25,
  cluster_columns = FALSE,
  cluster_row_slices = TRUE,
  show_row_names = FALSE,
  show_column_names = TRUE,
  column_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 8),
  row_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 4),
  row_gap = unit(0, "mm"),
  top_annotation = column_anno,
  heatmap_legend_param = list(
    title = "Z-score",
    direction = "vertical"
  )
)

spikein_heatmap_wt

Cairo::Cairo(
  file = "/Volumes/One Touch/CUT_RUN/Pdx1_spikein_heatmap_withWT.png",
  bg = "white", type = "png",
  units = "in", width = 7, height = 8,
  pointsize = 12, dpi = 300
)
spikein_heatmap_wt
dev.off()

print("Heatmap with WT saved!")
```


```{r load_data}
# Load pre-computed spike-in results
result_spikein_Delta207 <- read.table(
  "/Volumes/One Touch/CUT_RUN/Pdx1_spikein_WT_vs_Delta207.txt",
  sep = "\t", header = TRUE
)

# Define peakid function
peakid <- function(df){
  df %>%
    mutate(peakid = paste(chr, start, end, sep = ".")) %>%
    relocate(peakid, .before = "chr")
}

result_spikein_Delta207 <- peakid(result_spikein_Delta207)

# Lost peaks (sig lost in Delta207)
Delta207_lost_spikein <- result_spikein_Delta207 %>%
  dplyr::filter(padj < 0.05) %>%
  dplyr::filter(log2FoldChange <= -0.585)

# Retained peaks (not significant)
Delta207_retained_spikein <- result_spikein_Delta207 %>%
  dplyr::filter(is.na(padj) | padj >= 0.05) %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(baseMean)) %>%
  dplyr::filter(baseMean > 20)  # minimum coverage

print(paste("Lost peaks:", nrow(Delta207_lost_spikein)))
print(paste("Retained peaks:", nrow(Delta207_retained_spikein)))
```

```{r}
# ===== DEEPTOOLS COMPUTE MATRIX =====
# Using MERGED bigwigs instead of individual replicates

cmd_matrix <- paste(
  "computeMatrix reference-point",
  "--referencePoint center",
  "-b 3000 -a 3000",
  "-S bigwig_files/spikein_merged/WT_merged_spikein.bw","bigwig_files/spikein_merged/Delta207_merged_spikein.bw","bigwig_files/spikein_merged/Delta216_merged_spikein.bw","bigwig_files/spikein_merged/DeltaC_merged_spikein.bw","bigwig_files/spikein_merged/mCherry_merged_spikein.bw",
  "-R Delta207_spikein_lost.bed",
  "Delta207_spikein_retained.bed",
  "--skipZeros --binSize 10 -p max",
  "-o Delta207_lost_vs_retained_merged_matrix.gz"
)

system(cmd_matrix)
print("Matrix computed!")

# For the profile plot
cmd_profile <- paste(
  "plotProfile",
  "--matrixFile Delta207_lost_vs_retained_merged_matrix.gz",
  "--outFileName Delta207_lost_vs_retained_merged_profile.png",
  "--plotHeight 10 --plotWidth 12",
  "--plotType lines",
  "--refPointLabel 'Binding Site'",  
  "--perGroup",
  "--yMax 175",
  "--yAxisLabel 'Mean Coverage'",
  "--regionsLabel 'Lost Peaks' 'Retained Peaks'",
  "--samplesLabel WT 'Pdx1∆207' 'Pdx1∆216' 'Pdx1∆C' mCherry-EV",
  "--colors black '#6BAED6' green  orange red",
  "--outFileNameData Delta207_lost_vs_retained_merged_profile.txt",
  "--dpi 300"
)

system(cmd_profile)
system("open Delta207_lost_vs_retained_merged_profile.png")

```

```{r}
bigwigs <- paste(
  "bigwig_files/spikein_merged/WT_merged_spikein.bw","bigwig_files/spikein_merged/Delta207_merged_spikein.bw","bigwig_files/spikein_merged/Delta216_merged_spikein.bw","bigwig_files/spikein_merged/DeltaC_merged_spikein.bw","bigwig_files/spikein_merged/mCherry_merged_spikein.bw"
)

groups <- list(
  list(name = "lost", bed = "Delta207_spikein_lost.bed", label = "Lost Peaks"),
  list(name = "retained", bed = "Delta207_spikein_retained.bed", label = "Retained Peaks")
)

for (group in groups) {
  
  message(paste("Processing:", group$label))
  
  matrix_out <- sprintf("Delta207_%s_matrix.gz", group$name)
  plot_out <- sprintf("Delta207_%s_profile.png", group$name)
  data_out <- sprintf("Delta207_%s_profile_data.txt", group$name)
  
  cmd_matrix <- paste(
    "computeMatrix reference-point",
    "--referencePoint center",
    "-b 3000 -a 3000",
    "-S", bigwigs,
    "-R", group$bed,
    "--skipZeros --binSize 10 -p max",
    "-o", matrix_out
  )
  system(cmd_matrix)
  
  cmd_profile <- paste(
    "plotProfile",
    "--matrixFile", matrix_out,
    "--outFileName", plot_out,
    "--plotHeight 10 --plotWidth 12",
    "--plotType lines",
    "--refPointLabel ' Pdx1 Binding Site'",  
    "--perGroup",
    "--yMin 0",              
    "--yMax 200",       
    "--yAxisLabel 'Mean Coverage'",
    sprintf("--regionsLabel '%s'", group$label),
    "--samplesLabel WT 'Pdx1∆207' 'Pdx1∆216' 'Pdx1∆C' mCherry-EV",
    "--colors black '#6BAED6' green orange red",
    "--dpi 300"
  )
  system(cmd_profile)
}
```

```{r}
library(ggplot2)

volcano_data <- as.data.frame(result_spikein_Delta207) %>%
  rownames_to_column("peak_id") %>%
  filter(!is.na(padj)) %>%
  mutate(
    significance = case_when(
      padj < 0.05 & log2FoldChange <= -0.585 ~ "Lost",
      padj < 0.05 & log2FoldChange >= 0.585  ~ "Gained",
      TRUE ~ "Not Significant"
    ),
    neg_log10_padj = -log10(padj)
  )

anno_slim <- Delta207_lost_spikein_anno_df %>%
  dplyr::select(peak_id = peakid, SYMBOL) %>%
  distinct(peak_id, .keep_all = TRUE)

volcano_data <- volcano_data %>%
  left_join(anno_slim, by = "peak_id")

top_lost <- volcano_data %>%
  filter(significance == "Lost") %>%
  arrange(padj) %>%
  head(20)

volcano_plot <- ggplot(
  volcano_data,
  aes(x = log2FoldChange,
      y = neg_log10_padj,
      color = significance)) +
  geom_point(size = 1.5, alpha = 0.6) +
  geom_text_repel(
    data = top_lost,
    aes(label = SYMBOL),
    size = 3,
    fontface = "italic",
    max.overlaps = 20,
    box.padding = 0.5
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(
    "Lost" = "#D73027",
    "Gained" = "#4575B4",
    "Not Significant" = "grey70"
  )) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = c(-0.585, 0.585),
             linetype = "dashed",
             color = "grey50") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.05),
             linetype = "dashed",
             color = "grey50") +
  theme_classic() +
  labs(
    title = "Pdx1 Delta207 vs WT",
    x = "Log2 Fold Change (Delta207 vs WT)",
    y = "-log10(adjusted p-value)",
    color = ""
  ) +

    plot.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 11),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 12),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 11)
  )
```

```{r}
  df = chisq_result$parameter,
  p_value = chisq_result$p.value,
  comparison = "Lost vs Retained Peak Distribution"
)

write.table(

  sep = "\t", row.names = FALSE, quote = FALSE
)
```

```{r}
assign_tf_family <- function(motif_name){
  case_when(
    grepl("Homeobox|Homeodomain|HOX|PDX|NKX|
           LHX|GSX|EMX|ISL|DLX|PBX|MEIS|
           ATOH|PROX|ARX|DBX|EN1|EN2|VAX|
           OTX|CRX|RAX",
          motif_name,
          ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "Homeodomain",
    grepl("bHLH|ASCL|NEUROD|NGN|TCF|
           MYOD|MYF|E-BOX",
          motif_name,
          ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "bHLH",
    grepl("ETS|ERG|ETV|FLI|ELK|PU.1|GABPA",
          motif_name,
          ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "ETS",
    grepl("Forkhead|FOXA|FOXO|FOXP|FOXM",
          motif_name,
          ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "Forkhead",
    grepl("Nuclear Receptor|NR|RXR|RAR|
           PPAR|ERR|HNF4",
          motif_name,
          ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "Nuclear Receptor",
    grepl("KLF|SP1|SP2|SP3|GC-box",
          motif_name,
          ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "KLF/SP",
    grepl("GATA|TAL|SCL",
          motif_name,
          ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "GATA",
    grepl("SOX|SRY|HMG",
          motif_name,
          ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "SOX/HMG",
    grepl("RFX|RFXANK",
          motif_name,
          ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "RFX",
    grepl("TEAD|YAP|TAZ",
          motif_name,
          ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "TEAD",
    grepl("NFI|NFIA|NFIB|NFIX",
          motif_name,
          ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "NFI",
    TRUE ~ "Other"
  )
}

known_lost_family <- known_lost %>%
  mutate(
    TF_family = assign_tf_family(known_lost[,1]),
    neg_log10_p = -log10(as.numeric(P.value)),
    pct_targets = as.numeric(
      gsub("%","",
           X..of.Target.Sequences.with.Motif))
  )

known_retained_family <- known_retained %>%
  mutate(
    TF_family = assign_tf_family(known_retained[,1]),
    neg_log10_p = -log10(as.numeric(P.value)),
    pct_targets = as.numeric(
      gsub("%","",
           X..of.Target.Sequences.with.Motif))
  )

family_summary_lost <- known_lost_family %>%
  group_by(TF_family) %>%
  summarise(
    best_neg_log10_p = max(neg_log10_p,
                           na.rm = TRUE),
    n_motifs = n(),
    mean_pct_targets = mean(pct_targets,
                            na.rm = TRUE),
    best_motif = known_lost[
      which.max(neg_log10_p), 1][1]
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(best_neg_log10_p)) %>%
  filter(TF_family != "Other")

family_summary_retained <- known_retained_family %>%
  group_by(TF_family) %>%
  summarise(
    best_neg_log10_p = max(neg_log10_p,
                           na.rm = TRUE),
    n_motifs = n(),
    mean_pct_targets = mean(pct_targets,
                            na.rm = TRUE),
    best_motif = known_retained[
      which.max(neg_log10_p), 1][1]
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(best_neg_log10_p)) %>%
  filter(TF_family != "Other")

print("Updated Best Motifs Lost")
for(fam in c("Homeodomain","CTCF","Forkhead")){
  get_best_motif(known_lost_family,
                 fam, NULL)
}

print("Updated Best Motifs Retained")
for(fam in c("KLF/SP","ETS","Homeodomain")){
  get_best_motif(known_retained_family,
                 fam, NULL)
}
```

```{r}

max_finite_lost <- max(
  family_summary_lost$best_neg_log10_p[
    is.finite(family_summary_lost$best_neg_log10_p)
  ]
)

max_finite_retained <- max(
  family_summary_retained$best_neg_log10_p[
    is.finite(family_summary_retained$best_neg_log10_p)
  ]
)

global_max <- max(max_finite_lost, 
                  max_finite_retained) * 1.1

family_summary_lost <- family_summary_lost %>%
  mutate(best_neg_log10_p_capped = ifelse(
    is.infinite(best_neg_log10_p),
    global_max,
    best_neg_log10_p
  ))

family_summary_retained <- family_summary_retained %>%
  mutate(best_neg_log10_p_capped = ifelse(
    is.infinite(best_neg_log10_p),
    global_max,
    best_neg_log10_p
  ))

family_summary_lost <- family_summary_lost %>%
  mutate(is_capped = is.infinite(best_neg_log10_p))

family_summary_retained <- family_summary_retained %>%
  mutate(is_capped = is.infinite(best_neg_log10_p))

print("Fixed lost peaks:")
print(family_summary_lost %>%
  dplyr::select(TF_family, 
                best_neg_log10_p_capped,
                is_capped))

print("Fixed retained peaks:")
print(family_summary_retained %>%
  dplyr::select(TF_family,
                best_neg_log10_p_capped,
                is_capped))
```

```{r}
sig_threshold <- -log10(0.05)


lost_family_plot <- ggplot(
  family_summary_lost %>% head(8),
  aes(x = best_neg_log10_p_capped,
      y = reorder(TF_family,
                  best_neg_log10_p_capped),
      fill = best_neg_log10_p_capped)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
```

```{r}
library(ggseqlogo)
library(cowplot)


get_best_motif <- function(known_results_df,
                           family_name,
                           motifs_raw){
  # Find best motif for this family
  family_rows <- known_results_df %>%
    filter(TF_family == family_name) %>%
    arrange(as.numeric(P.value))
  
  if(nrow(family_rows) == 0) return(NULL)
  

  best_motif_name <- family_rows[1, 1]
  print(paste("Best motif for", 
              family_name, ":", 
              best_motif_name))
  
  return(best_motif_name)
}



top_lost_families <- c("Homeodomain", 
                        "bHLH", 
                        "Forkhead")

 
top_retained_families <- c("KLF/SP",
                            "ETS",
                            "Homeodomain")


print("Best motifs for Lost Peaks")
for(fam in top_lost_families){
  get_best_motif(known_lost_family, 
                 fam, motifs_raw)
}

print("Best motifs for Retained Peaks")
for(fam in top_retained_families){
  get_best_motif(known_retained_family,
                 fam, motifs_raw)
}
```

```{r}
library(ggseqlogo)
library(cowplot)
library(ggplot2)

parse_homer_motif <- function(lines, motif_name){
  motif_idx <- grep(motif_name, lines, 
                    ignore.case = TRUE)
  
  if(length(motif_idx) == 0){
    print(paste("Motif not found:", motif_name))
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  start <- motif_idx[1] + 1
  
  next_headers <- grep("^>", lines)
  next_header <- next_headers[
    next_headers > motif_idx[1]][1]
  
  if(is.na(next_header)){
    end <- length(lines)
  } else {
    end <- next_header - 1
  }
  

  matrix_lines <- lines[start:end]
  matrix_lines <- matrix_lines[
    !grepl("^>|^$", matrix_lines)]
  

  pwm <- do.call(rbind, lapply(
    matrix_lines, function(x){
      as.numeric(strsplit(trimws(x), 
                          "\t|\\s+")[[1]][1:4])
    }))
  

  t(pwm)
}


lost_motifs_raw <- readLines(
  "homer_output/lost_known/knownResults.txt"
)


list.files("homer_output/lost_known/")
list.files("homer_output/retained_known/")
```

```{r}
save_individual_logo <- function(pwm, title, rank, target_pct, log_p, filename){
  if(is.null(pwm)) return(NULL)
  
  stat_subtitle <- paste0("Rank: ", rank, " | ", target_pct, "% | logP: ", log_p)
  
  p <- ggseqlogo(pwm, method = "probability", col_scheme = dna_colors) +
    theme_logo() +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(size = 20, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 11, hjust = 0.5, color = "grey30"), 
      axis.text.x = element_blank(),
      axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
      axis.title.x = element_blank(),
      plot.margin = margin(10, 10, 10, 10)
    ) +
    labs(title = title, subtitle = stat_subtitle)
  
  Cairo::Cairo(
    file = filename,
    bg = "white", type = "png",
    units = "in", width = 6, height = 2.8, # Slightly shorter height to fit the smaller font
    dpi = 300
  )
  print(p)
  dev.off()
}
```
